content.comment_body: Hello, I have a communication cable with an RS232 plug for my [product_name] due to my old laptop. I recently bought a desktop which does not have a serial port, and I'm trying to connect using a USB to serial adapter, but it doesn’t work. Is there any solution, or do I need to buy a new cable? I’m facing the same issue with my [product_name] communication.
Try installing the USB PC adapter driver...

Hello, This issue is common with USB to serial converters; most do not work with devices that require a genuine COM port. For this reason, I have used a PCMCIA card providing a real RS232 port. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties connecting [company_name] automation products to their PCs via USB-to-serial adapters, as these adapters are often incompatible with devices that need a true physical COM port. This leads to concerns about needing additional cables or hardware to establish communication.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward communication between [company_name] automation hardware and PCs using standard USB-to-serial adapters, without having to purchase extra adapters or specialized cables.
